title: Where the Maybe Goes
subtitle: Dr Ingrid Vasseur and Futures in Committee
summary: Dr Ingrid Vasseur, Lecturer and Convenor of Futures in Committee, follows the hedged language of foresight work from the scanning workshop into the committee room, and this short profile has her trace that route herself. It draws on Minuted Into Certainty, in which a typical scan entry's five hedges had gone by the time it was minuted. The video also marks an h-index of 25 that no researcher at the University has reached with fewer outputs.
topic: a promo profile of Dr Ingrid Vasseur in her own voice: the convenor of the School's seminar series, who follows the maybes of foresight talk into the committee room to see which survive the minutes, and whose h-index of 25 no one at the University has reached with fewer outputs

beats.title: Where the Maybe Goes
beats.tagline: Dr Ingrid Vasseur and Futures in Committee

beats.text: I follow those maybes into the committee room, to see which ones survive.
Every decision starts as a maybe. I want to know where the maybe goes.
